patch.value: Include CDC benchmark source in the 100/100/100/100 coverage contract

The pm-vcs coverage script explicitly excludes scripts/cdc-benchmark.ts. The full release gate is green and measures 39 source files, while the docstring gate sees 40; the benchmark is executable authored TypeScript and therefore the package cannot claim all-source 100/100/100/100 coverage under the current fleet requirement.

Inventory every authored executable TypeScript source file and reconcile the coverage and docstring scopes; include scripts/cdc-benchmark.ts or refactor its executable logic into measured source with real deterministic benchmark acceptance; measure statements, lines, branches and functions at 100% with no excludes, threshold reductions, skips or synthetic-only assertion; run the full release gate and real benchmark on the exact pushed head, then update the coverage evidence and PM links.
Every executable authored TypeScript source is measured at 100% across statements, lines, branches and functions, and the benchmark still runs against real file/object-store I/O.

The c8 invocation uses --exclude=scripts/cdc-benchmark.ts. Its LCOV lists 39 source files at 100% lines/branches/functions; docstring gate reports 40 source files. The benchmark script is not part of the measured gate.
